title: Deactivated is a claim, not evidence
desc: Three parties: the offboarding runbook, the identity provider and an app that is a SCIM service provider. The runbook deactivates the user at the identity provider, which sends the app a SCIM update of active. In RFC 7643, active is administrative status and its definitive meaning is determined by the service provider. A successful SCIM update therefore proves little about sessions, keys or tokens, so the runbook verifies each surface against its expected state.
